text:
alice: quick idea: 'leaseback' for active/active so a failover region can serve while origin keeps a lightweight legal snapshot. want tradeoffs.
ben: ok, what's in the snapshot? minimal metadata only.
carol: strawman: consent_version, jurisdiction_tag, snapshot_id, last_write_ts. signed by origin KMS.
david: important: no PII, only assertions. verify via signature in control plane.
eva: legal: fine if it's metadata + immutable audit. we need field list and retention policy.
alice: proto header example: `X-Region-Lease: v1; id=abc123; sig=BASE64` and `X-Region-Consent: eu=true; pii=false`.
carol: fallback order: local-warm -> same-jurisdiction -> global-readonly. add hysteresis to avoid churn.
ben: telemetry: lease_issued, lease_validated_ms, lease_denied_reason.
david: swapback: propose swapback_safe_window=30s and graceful drain to avoid stale writes.
eva: require audit event: `lease_issued {snapshot_id, origin, target, ts, signer_kid}`.
ops-bot: canary rollout started at 4820000300 :robot_face:.
carol: next: implement header + KMS signing (owner: carol).
ben: I'll add telemetry hooks (owner: ben).
david: I'll draft chaos tests for swapback races (owner: david).
eva: I'll confirm legal fields in a quick review tomorrow (owner: eva).
alice: thanks all. will follow up after prototype metrics. :thumbsup:
